description_en: Modifies the description, input parameters, risk level, and other settings of a rule
description_zh: 修改规则的描述信息、规则入参和风险等级等
name: UpdateConfigRule

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For information about how to obtain a rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html

parameters.help_zh: 规则描述。最多输入500个字符

parameters.help_en: The input parameters of the rule
parameters.help_zh: 规则参数

parameters.help_en:
The execution frequency of the rule. Valid values:
One_Hour: 1 hour.
Three_Hours: 3 hours.
Six_Hours: 6 hours.
Twelve_Hours: 12 hours.
TwentyFour_Hours (default): 24 hours.

If `ConfigRuleTriggerTypes` is set to `ScheduledNotification`, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
规则执行周期。取值：
One_Hour：1小时。
Three_Hours：3小时。
Six_Hours：6小时。
Twelve_Hours：12小时。
TwentyFour_Hours（默认值）：24小时。

当`ConfigRuleTriggerTypes`设置为`ScheduledNotification`时，需要设置该参数
parameters.name: maximum_execution_frequency

parameters.help_en: The resource types to which the rule applies. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则评估的资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:
1: high risk.

The `ClientToken` value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length

parameters.name: resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type of the rule. Valid values:

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: configuration change.

ScheduledNotification: periodic execution.

Only custom rules can have this parameter modified

规则触发机制。取值：

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：配置变更。

ScheduledNotification：周期执行。

仅自定义规则能修改该参数

仅适用于规则模板
parameters.name: resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源组ID中的资源无效，即不对该资源组内的资源评估。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is deprecated. Use the `TagsScope` parameter instead.

The rule applies only to resources that are bound with the specified tag.

This parameter applies only to rule templates, and `TagKeyScope` and `TagValueScope` must be set together
parameters.help_zh:
已废弃，请使用 `TagsScope` 字段。

规则仅对绑定指定标签的资源生效。

仅适用于规则模板，且`TagKeyScope`和`TagValueScope`必须同时设置
parameters.name: tag_key_scope

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is deprecated. Use the `TagsScope` parameter instead.

The rule applies only to resources that are bound with the specified tag.

This parameter applies only to rule templates, and `TagKeyScope` and `TagValueScope` must be set together
parameters.help_zh:
已废弃，请使用 `TagsScope` 字段。

规则仅对绑定指定标签的资源生效。

仅适用于规则模板，且`TagKeyScope`和`TagValueScope`必须同时设置
parameters.name: tag_value_scope

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship when the `TagsScope` parameter has multiple values. For example, if `TagsScope` is set to `"TagsScope.1.TagKey":"a","TagsScope.1.TagValue":"a","TagsScope.2.TagKey":"b","TagsScope.2.TagValue":"b"` and this parameter is set to `AND`, the rule applies only to resources that are bound with both the `a:a` and `b:b` tags. If this parameter is not specified, the default logic `OR` is used.

This parameter can also be used with the deprecated `TagKeyScope` parameter (not recommended). For example, if `TagKeyScope` is set to `ECS,OSS` and this parameter is set to `AND`, the rule applies only to resources that are bound with both the `ECS` and `OSS` tags.

Valid values:

AND: logical AND.

OR: logical OR
parameters.help_zh:
参数`TagsScope` 取多值时的逻辑关系，例如：当参数`TagsScope`取值为`"TagsScope.1.TagKey":"a","TagsScope.1.TagValue":"a","TagsScope.2.TagKey":"b","TagsScope.2.TagValue":"b"`时，如果该参数为`AND`，则表示规则仅对同时绑定标签`a:a`和`b:b`的资源生效。不填写取默认逻辑`OR`。

也可以用于已废弃字段`TagKeyScope`字段（不推荐），例如：当参数`TagKeyScope`取值为`ECS,OSS`时，如果该参数为`AND`，则表示规则仅对同时绑定标签`ECS`和`OSS`的资源生效。

取值：

AND：与。

OR：或
parameters.name: tag_key_logic_scope
